newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares rally to 10-week high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares rally to 10-week high.

text.p: Austrian shares on Tuesday saw their highest close since June 28 on the back of record gains in Germany and a feisty overnight close on Wall Street.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips raced to an intraday high of 1,090.11 before easing to close 6.71 points, or 0.62 percent firmer, at 1,088.52.
October ATX futures added 14 points to close at 1,090.
Traders were divided over whether there would be a consolidation or further upside advances in the short term. There was unanimity, however, that the underlying tone was positive.
"I would expect it to slip back to 1,080, but it could equally head for 1,100, going on the gains of the last few days," a trader said.
Dealers said Friday's expiry of October ATX futures would be the market's main focus to the end of the week. "Until Friday anything's possible," one said.
Five ATX issues ended down and 16 up. The leading gainer was paper maker Leykam, which continued its recent recovery and climbing 18 schillings, or 6.02 percent, to 317.
Leykam shares took a tumble last month when the firm's Dutch parent KNP said it was abandoning further investment in its paper producing unit.
Airport group Flughafen Wien was the leading decliner, shedding 18.8 schillings, or 3.16 percent, to close at a year-low of 546.2.
Flughafen has come under heavy selling pressure since it announced disappointing half-year earnings in September.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index rose 0.57 percent to 415.59. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
